mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Reference image 1 shows a pair of curtains that are OPEN. Draw these exact same curtains (the same oatmeal-beige linen, the same dark wooden rod with a round knob at each end, the same fold style, colours, ink linework and flat cel-like shading, the same size and placement in the frame), changed only as follows: the curtains are now CLOSED (drawn shut). Both panels hang straight down from the rod and meet in the middle with no gap between them, the tie-back cords removed, the fabric falling in even deep vertical folds from rod to hem.
Reference image 2 is a style reference only: match its ink linework, shading and palette; do not copy its subject.
Style: flat posterized colour fills in three or four tonal steps, cel-like, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture; thin dark ink outlines and small ink hatch and tick marks in the folds; nothing glossy.
Single subject centred with a generous white margin on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) filling every edge, no ground shadow, no scenery. No text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: a gap between the curtains, tie-backs, cords, open curtains, window frame, glass, wall, room, tassels, patterns, lace, a different rod, a different colour, watercolour, glossy highlights, photo, 3D render, scenery behind the subject, grey background, off-white background, checkerboard.
